verdict.rationale: Copilot is itself the built-in assistant. First-party docs describe delegating work in several ways: assigning tasks to agents that plan and execute autonomously in the background, cloud agent working independently, `@copilot` mentions on PRs, scheduled or event-driven automations, and agent mode editing files in the IDE. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of task delegation, since community evidence covers only code completion.
